effect: text (default) plain text; json returns structured JSON with result/session id/metadata incl. total_cost_usd and per-model cost breakdown; stream-json newline-delimited JSON events, last line is the result message
controls how -p reads input; stream-json pairs with --output-format stream-json for bidirectional streaming

print mode only; validates structured output against the schema after the run, delivered in the structured_output field; exits with an error on an invalid schema; format keyword accepted as annotation only, not enforced

print mode only; caps agentic turns; exits with an error when reached; no limit by default; with --input-format stream-json a message still queued when the limit ends a turn starts a new turn with its own limit

print mode only; hard dollar cap on API spend; subagent spend counts toward it; once reached, spawning another subagent fails with Budget limit reached and running background subagents are stopped; enforcement requires v2.1.217+
sets the starting permission mode; manual is an alias for default (v2.1.200+); overrides defaultMode from settings; -p defaults to default (Manual) when unset

print mode only; host (default) sends prompts to the Agent SDK host or --permission-prompt-tool; none denies anything that would need a human answer instead of blocking, for unattended/scheduled jobs; requires v2.1.259+

non-interactive mode: names an MCP tool to answer permission prompts; Claude Code waits for that server to connect up to the MCP_TIMEOUT startup timeout (30s default); cannot approve a tool marked as requiring user interaction (converted to deny, v2.1.199+)
tools that execute without prompting; does not restrict which tools are available (use --tools for that)
deny rules; a bare tool name removes the tool from context, a scoped rule like Bash(rm *) denies only matching calls

skips auto-discovery of hooks, skills, custom commands, subagents, installed plugins, MCP servers, auto memory and CLAUDE.md; never reads OAuth/keychain credentials, needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or provider creds set explicitly; recommended mode for scripted/SDK calls, will become the -p default in a future release

loads MCP servers; with -p, Claude Code waits for still-pending servers up to the MCP_TIMEOUT startup timeout (30s default) before the first turn; a server with a cached tool list skips the wait (v2.1.221+)
use only the MCP servers passed via --mcp-config for this session, ignoring project/user-configured MCP servers
loads the most recent conversation in the current directory; skips sessions created with claude -p or the Agent SDK unless combined with -p itself, in which case those are included
resumes a session by id or name to continue it non-interactively with a new query
appends custom text to the end of the default system prompt (works in -p too)
loads a settings JSON for this session only, e.g. to set apiKeyHelper or sandbox config without touching a settings file on disk
defines custom subagents dynamically; with --print the value can be a path to a JSON file (v2.1.281+)
adds a working directory Claude can read/edit; in --bare mode, skills under its .claude/skills/ still load, but .claude/commands/ and .claude/agents/ do not
print mode only; disables saving the session to disk so it cannot be resumed
sets the effort level for the current session; does not persist
overrides the model setting and ANTHROPIC_MODEL for the session

loads only the named settings sources; a list without local never reads .claude/settings.local.json; user alone reads neither project settings files nor .mcp.json; the cli-reference flags table has no row for it
